item: Row J: the upgrade from main's flip-flopping seeder is a test, and the limits of its repair are executable
refs: R152; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: Nine rows of damage measured from a database main's own seeder wrote (two boots, default then legal seed) are replayed onto a fresh install; the current seeder must restore the seven erased feeds, report no edit nobody made, and land on a fresh install's rows, baselines included. Three more tests pin the limits: an operator's own feed, name or region survives the repair, a feed cleared on an undamaged row is never refilled, and a feed re-added then cleared again before upgrading is restored (the known R152 residual, by construction).
